bounds: three criteria (two hard, one deferred), at most two amendments

cases.purpose: Owner and worker are different parties, independent approver required.
Owner also does the work, independent approver required: no amendment can take effect.
Owner also does the work, no independent approver required: self-granted amendments take effect and are marked.
Delivery is reachable with hard gates still in place.
Fulfilment is reachable with a deferred gate in place.
An owner's amendment can open the way to delivery, so amendments are not dead rules.
With an independent approver required and owner equal to worker, no amendment opens the way to delivery.
Planted defect: the worker's amendment is accepted.
Planted defect: a self-granted amendment takes effect although an independent approver is required.
Planted defect: a self-granted amendment is not marked.
Planted defect: a gate changes with no amendment on record.
Planted defect: a hard gate whose check has not run is treated as passed.
Planted defect: an open deferred gate does not block fulfilment.
